title: Surreal Skull Symphony
description: A vibrant surreal scene inside a cracked purple room with a large broken ceiling revealing a stormy sea with ships and lightning. A giant green skull wearing red glasses sits with a white cat on its shoulder reading sheet music, while a blue-haired mermaid goddess floats above emitting turquoise energy and small human figures; below, two skeletal grim reapers in black robes play a red spiral drum and a purple saxophone amid flying musical notes and papers.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene in a cracked purple room with broken ceiling showing stormy ocean with ships and lightning. Giant green skull wearing red glasses and blue goggles, white cat on shoulder reading music sheets with red quill. Blue haired mermaid goddess with staff floating in turquoise energy swirl with small human silhouettes. Two skeletal grim reapers in black robes, one playing large red spiral drum, other playing purple saxophone. Flying sheet music and papers everywhere, dramatic lighting, vibrant colors, detailed digital painting style
